scope: non-desktop public SEP/presentation; no OS cache purge, no real model speed claim

dataset.attachments: Run subset: text/image/file/image; 29-byte UTF-8 file and distinct 2x2 PNGs from existing mixed fixture
dataset.family: only actual public producer: one parent/one child with two history pages; absent capability requires fixed contract evidence

iterations.coldDefinition: new owned AgentKit/harness process, existing immutable runtime and same dataset; OS file cache uncontrolled and recorded
iterations.warmDefinition: same process after one excluded initialization iteration
iterations.percentile: nearest-rank; retain all samples including failures

measurement.memory: per-process OS resident-size samples every 50ms; report sampled peak (not exact allocator peak), include sampling limits
measurement.machine: record hardware/OS/power/thermal before run; same machine and power mode baseline/candidate
measurement.latencyStartEnd: original intent/request accepted timestamp to matching source publication; reconnect explicit intent to same-session inventory/history convergence
measurement.provider: loopback deterministic fixture with explicit holds excluded from latency interval; raw events retained
measurement.comparison: baseline/candidate same supported dataset; new capability without baseline must meet absolute budget and be marked no-comparable-baseline, not a regression pass
measurement.failurePolicy: missing sample/failed protocol/capability mismatch is failed or not_run with reason; no replacing or dropping failed iterations

notRunReasons: Candidate functional #55/#56 still partial; Native busy queue Kernel #86 failure remains blocking
No comparable baseline/candidate performance samples collected; this is a preregistered profile, not acceptance evidence

executionRecipe.datasetDefinition: 100 initial nonempty body-text messages per ordinary session: 50 user + 50 final assistant, each exactly 1024 UTF-8 bytes; first 10 turns each execute one original public read tool; tool call/result records are additional and excluded from body-text count
executionRecipe.seedProof: public history readback validates ordered body byte counts/digests and 10 paired original call/result groups; baseline/candidate normalized content equal; opaque ids/times retained separately

cold.arrangement: new owned home per iteration; public seed, retire seeder, launch a fresh measured harness/consumer over that owned dataset
order: explicit reconnect to original pointer/history convergence
one send and settlement per session

warm.growth: two ordinary sessions retained; each iteration sends exactly once to each session, adding one user and one final assistant body per session; no tools added after seed
warm.trajectory: steady-warm; no reconnect inside this group; fail if consumer or owned harness PID/start identity changes unexpectedly

iterationOrder: new usable original-source snapshot via public history close/open
one send and settlement per session
executionRecipe.page20: Each iteration uses the same owned endpoint Arc but a fresh public MemoryProjectionStore fed only real follow(max_messages=20) bootstrap/events, then actual journal history_page(20)/apply_page or Pi load_earlier_conversation(20)/original follow publication. No private trimming, synthetic page or slicing. Pi shares its endpoint window map, so restore the Runtime view with public close/open50 after dropping the page probe; its RPC process remains alive.

latency.snapshot: original connect/open intent before dispatch to correct usable original-source projection; harness startup-to-ready recorded separately
latency.send: subscribe before public intent; record durable-user and first matching assistant content frame separately; 2s budget applies to assistant content, excludes optimistic echo
latency.page: original page20 request to real new source records in projection, keeping prior record identity/order
latency.reconnect: explicit reconnect intent to new epoch, both original pointers/inventory and original history window converged; ready alone insufficient

executionRecipe.family: separate one-parent/one-child workload with two public history pages; Native same-session bounded child versus Pi/DSH physical child session counts disclosed. Basic family has comparable baseline; do not silently insert extra sessions/tool groups into ordinary two-session dataset
executionRecipe.rss: 50ms OS resident-size samples, PID/start identity and owned descendants; AgentKit and harness budgets each apply to simultaneous owned-tree total peak; provider recorded separately; missed short processes and sampling limits disclosed
executionRecipe.runOrder: Interleaved cold baseline/candidate pairs; steady-warm baseline then candidate; reconnect-lifecycle baseline then candidate, each with separate owned seed and identical growth schedule; no percentile pooling across trajectories or cache purge
executionRecipe.failurePolicy: retain failed samples; no replacements; if an iteration fails to reach the preregistered growth state, dependent subsequent samples not_run with reason rather than comparing unequal datasets

preregistrationCorrection.reason: Pi endpoint close during reconnect closes/recreates RPC child processes; journal close/open retains historical entries, so repeated mutable-window paging can exhaust the finite dataset. Preserve all original budgets and genuine same-process warm; split lifecycle and use fresh public-source page probes.

order: explicit reconnect to original two pointers and converged history/inventory
one send and settlement per session
reconnectLifecycle.piLifecycle: normal reconnect closes and re-creates session Node RPC children; include all close/version-probe/start/history convergence time in reconnect budget and all process RSS/cleanup; not Unsupported and not same-harness-warm

executionRecipe.runtimeWindow: Runtime default follows50 and may legitimately retain earlier loaded journal cache after public close/open. Report requested window and actual retained history separately; never call it initial-follow20 or claim journal cache was trimmed. Snapshot timing starts before the original public history read/reset intent and ends only after a new ready publication.
executionRecipe.fixed50Path: One separately labelled public RunController actual50 sample per scope outside the repeated page20 trajectory; no substituting empty/exhausted page results. Existing original-control functional50 evidence remains independently bound.
executionRecipe.samePidReconnectAssumption: The previous Pi same-harness-PID reconnect combination is topology-inconsistent, not passed or Unsupported. Genuine same-PID warm remains required and is covered only by the separate steady-warm group.
